maxTurns.description: Most turns the agent may take. Empty means 10.

model.description: Model name to pass to the agent. Empty uses the agent's default.

prompt.description: What to ask the agent. It is passed as a single argument, never through a shell.

provider.description: Which agent to run. Only claude-code so far.

tools.description: Tools the agent may use, for example Read, Grep, Edit, Bash(go test:*). Empty means read-only: Read, Grep, Glob. A tool not listed is refused, because the agent cannot ask for approval in a pipeline.

network.description: Outbound network access: none cuts the step off from every network, egress allows it. Empty means egress for now.

secrets.description: Names of the secrets this step receives as environment variables. Values come from the server or the local environment (FORGELINE_SECRET_<NAME>), never from the pipeline file. A step gets only what it lists.

agent.description: Run a coding agent with a prompt instead of a script. The image must contain the agent's command line. Set this or run or command.

command.description: Command and arguments, run without a shell. Set this or run, not both.

env.description: Environment variables for the step. Names must be valid identifiers.

id.description: Unique step identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

image.description: Container image the step runs in.

inputs.description: Workspace-relative file globs that make up the step's cache key. A step without inputs is never cached.

needs.description: IDs of steps that must succeed before this one starts.

permissions.description: What the step is allowed to do. See docs/design/005-threat-model.md.

run.description: Shell script to run. Set this or command, not both.

timeout.description: Maximum run time as a duration such as 30s or 10m. Must be positive.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory inside the container.

workflow.description: Start a GitHub Actions workflow and wait for it, instead of running a container. Only the Forgeline server can do this (it holds the GitHub credentials); the step has no image, script, environment or permissions. Set this or run or command or agent.

detach.description: Do not wait: the step succeeds as soon as GitHub accepts the request. By default the step waits and fails if the workflow does not succeed.

inputs.description: Workflow inputs, at most 25, each value at most 1000 bytes.

ref.description: Branch to run it on. It must be a branch the allow list permits for the repository.

repo.description: Repository as owner/name. It must be on the server's GitHub allow list.

workflow.description: The workflow's file name such as ci.yml, or its number. The file needs on: workflow_dispatch.

description: A Forgeline pipeline, spec version v1alpha1.

name.description: Pipeline name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

steps.description: The steps to run. At least one is required.

title: Forgeline pipeline
